**Rationale:** The claim asserts that anti-CD47 treatment "improves survival in human patients," but the evidence packet contains only preclinical data: in vitro macrophage assays, mouse xenograft studies, and mouse syngeneic tumor models. No human clinical trial results, patient survival data, or prospective human outcomes are presented. The described biological mechanism (CD47-SIRP-alpha blockade enabling phagocytosis) is used to justify the leap from mouse efficacy to human therapeutic benefit—a hallmark of mechanism_vs_evidence error. While the preclinical work is solid, the conclusion substantially exceeds what the evidence supports.
